subject: TruMed deployment: clarifying SSO / KMS / logging impact on Private vs Dedicated
messages:
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@trumed.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-01-15 09:12 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: deployment requirements recap & quick asks

Hi Samir —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap of what we heard and a few clarifying questions so we can recommend the right hosting path (Hosted / Dedicated / Private).

Recap from call:
- TruMed is evaluating Redwood for patient-facing summarization and PHI-handling workflows.
- Primary concerns: cryptographic key custody, SSO / identity lifecycle, and long-term audit/log retention.
- Preferred: Private VPC or on-prem if KMS/HSM requirements are strict; otherwise Dedicated could work for isolation + reserved capacity.

Questions to clarify (helps determine Private vs Dedicated):
1) KMS / HSM: do you require customer-managed HSM (FIPS 140-2/3 HSM) for all encryption keys (BYOK) or is a cloud KMS with customer-controlled keys sufficient? If HSM, is AWS CloudHSM acceptable or do you require a customer-hosted HSM appliance?
2) SSO: are you using SAML 2.0 IdP (Okta/OneLogin/Azure AD)? Do you need Just-in-Time (JIT) provisioning and SCIM group sync?
3) Logging / retention: what is the minimum retention policy for request/audit logs and at what granularity (7 years, 5 years, WORM required)? Any legal/regulatory retention obligations?
4) Connectivity: do you need private peering (VPC peering/Transit Gateway) or an on-prem appliance (air gap)?

Attachments: I attached our Private deployment one-pager and a short pricing sketch.

Proposed next steps:
- If you confirm HSM + 5+ year WORM logs, we'll prioritize a Private deployment discussion and loop in Solutions Engineering to size the appliance and runbook.
- If cloud KMS + 1–2 year logs, we can scope Dedicated and provide a performance/commit proposal.

Can you reply with the specifics above by EOD Friday? If easier, loop your security or procurement contacts and we can run a brief technical call.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

---
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-01-15 11:02 -0800
Subject: RE: Follow-up: deployment requirements recap & quick asks

Jasmine —

Good notes. Couple internal points while we wait for Samir:
- If they require HSM for key custody (not just KMS), that essentially forces Private (or a dedicated appliance) because Dedicated supports CMK via cloud KMS but we only offer validated HSM integrations in Private via PKCS#11/CloudHSM or customer HSM proxy.
- We should confirm whether their security team will accept AWS CloudHSM (we've done this for other health customers) or need an on-prem HSM with physical custody. If on-prem HSM is required, timeline and procurement will change materially.
- For logging: our hosted & dedicated logs are retained per customer-configurable policies but very long retention (5+ years with WORM guarantees) is currently a Private feature because of archival and write-once policies in certain regions.

I'll prep an SE ask for a short technical deep-dive. Also — set calendar hold for a 45-min call next week (we can invite Solutions Eng + Infra) once Samir confirms.

Ben
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

---
From: Samir Patel <samir@trumed.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@trumed.com; security@trumed.com
Date: 2026-01-16 10:22 -0500
Subject: RE: Follow-up: deployment requirements recap & quick asks

Jasmine —

Thanks for the recap. A few clarifications from security/procurement:
1) KMS/HSM: We require HSM-backed key custody for patient data keys. Cloud-hosted HSM is acceptable (AWS CloudHSM) provided we can BYOK and audit key usage. We are not prepared to provision or manage physical HSM appliances on-prem at this stage.
2) SSO: We use Okta with SAML 2.0. We need JIT provisioning and SCIM provisioning for groups and deprovisioning on termination.
3) Logging retention: Compliance requires 5 years of immutable audit logs (WORM preferred) and the ability to export logs monthly to our archival S3 account.
4) Connectivity & isolation: We prefer Private VPC with customer-managed peering, but if Dedicated can satisfy HSM + WORM log retention + private peering, we are open to that as a faster path.

Procurement: procurement@trumed.com — please send any standard security questionnaires. Our preferred contracting timeline is end of Q1 (target March 31).

Samir Patel
Director, Cloud Security — TruMed Health
samir@trumed.com

---
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com; laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: samir@trumed.com, procurement@trumed.com
Date: 2026-01-18 15:45 -0800
Subject: RE: Follow-up: deployment requirements recap & quick asks — internal next steps

Team —

Samir confirmed their requirements (HSM via CloudHSM acceptable, Okta SAML + SCIM, 5yr WORM logs, Private VPC preferred but Dedicated acceptable if we can satisfy HSM + WORM + peering).

Immediate next actions (owners):
- Ben: open SE request and ask Solutions Eng to confirm whether Dedicated can be configured to wire CloudHSM + WORM-like retention and private peering (ETA: 48 hours).
- Laura: start procurement outreach; request TruMed's security questionnaire and confirm contracting template options (ETA: 2 business days).
- Jasmine: draft a two-path proposal (Private VPC baseline + Dedicated fallback) with high-level timeline and cost delta; include a note about lead times for HSM and long-term archival costs. Draft due: EOD Tuesday.

Risks / notes:
- If SE reports Dedicated cannot guarantee WORM archivability or enforce immutable retention in their regulatory region, Private will be the only path. That will add procurement lead time and deployment runbook work.
- We should price both paths and surface any one-time integration/setup fees for CloudHSM and peering.

I attached the Private one-pager and the short pricing sketch I shared earlier to send to procurement. Samir — thanks, I will share the two-path proposal Tuesday and book a technical session with our SEs once Ben confirms availability.

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_private_pricing_v2.pdf, trumed-infra-q1-2026.pdf
